Amazing work! Penny always looks fantastic afterwards and I’m glad she isn’t kenneled while there, that’s a plus!

The groomer before the Dog house

Thank you

They’re the best! Wonderful with my puppy and he always looks amazing.
Ruby is just the best. She loves Jackson and he loves her and always gets a fantastic haircut from her!

I needed a last-minute grooming appointment and they were incredibly accommodating. The staff was friendly, professional, and made the entire experience easy. My dog came back looking and smelling fantastic. Clean as a whistle! I highly recommend them and will definitely be returning.
So glad we found this place, they treated my pups and us very well! We came for a walk in nail grind for two small dogs and it was very easy
My Hank loves going to DOG HOUSE! They are a loving family owned operated business!

Sonia has groomed our sweet Joey several times. Her care, expertise, and sensitivity with Joey, is so very much appreciated.
The Dog House and Sonia are exactly what you want for your fur baby!

I’m so happy to have found this gem of a place.  I needed a reco of a new place to take my baby for her monthly groom as our usual gal loved away, and I was so nervous to start with a new groomer- Ruby absolutely doted on my girl and made her so comfortable-). Their service is fantastic- so efficient and thorough and they have doggy day care too!  Highly highly recommend I’m so grateful to the person who initially recommended them to us, 10 out of 10 for friendliness, cleanliness, attention to detail!!!!
. Thank you Sonia (Sonja). You are the best 😘
They are the best  , Pancho loves them

First time customer !! I was very pleased with the service and the hospitality they provided me and my partner  . They made us feel comfortable leaving our baby there….! We will definitely be back. Thank you Sonia for taking care of my baby.
Dog House boarded my little guy for a few days and also groomed him. He loved it there and we will definitely be using them again!
I had a great experience. Super friendly groomers! My dog had pretty bad matting, and she de-matted her everything looks even and great!
The Dog House is a wonderful place for grooming. Everybody's is extremely friendly and knowledgeable. Sonja took amazing care of my Spaniel. She looks, feels and smells fantastic!

Been coming here for 10
Years. Always great service. Quick. Kind to
The fur pups. I wouldn’t go anywhere else!
Louie looks fabulous! Thank you for taking such good care of him!!

We recently adopted a dog and had such a wonderful experience with The Dog House in Studio City. As new pet parents, we wanted a place where our pup would feel safe, comfortable, and cared for and they exceeded our expectations.

The staff was incredibly kind, attentive, and genuinely excited to meet our new family member. They took the time to make sure our dog felt comfortable and kept us updated throughout the visit, even sending a grooming report after his service. It was clear that everyone there truly loves animals and treats them like their own.

Our dog came home happy, relaxed, and well cared for, which gave us so much peace of mind. We’re so grateful to have found such a welcoming and professional place in the neighborhood. Highly recommend The Dog House to anyone looking for quality care for their furry family members!
Thank you Jenna
Great service! Best haircuts my dog has gotten so far
Always have had such a good experience with The Dog House grooming my pups!!
Thank you Izzy!!
Great groomer. Ruby is the best!
Thanks a lot, Judith!!

This used to be a great grooming spot, especially in the North Hollywood area where many places tend to overcharge. They stood out as one of the few reasonably priced options. Unfortunately, they’ve now gone down the same path and raised their prices significantly. It’s disappointing to see a place that was once affordable become just like the rest.
Thank you Claire!!
My cat got her first bath at Dog House and came home fluffy, flea-less and fearless. I would absolutely trust them to groom my pets again! 🐾💕
Best place bring both of my pups. Sonia is the best! So patient and kind. Been coming here for 6 years. Started bringing my pup simba and she does a great job in keeping him calm and safe
they did such a good job on my baby boy pepper! 10/10
Thank you Shannan

The Dog House groomers are the BEST in the business. My Ripple always  comes home clean., clipped, and coiffed to the nines. Carlos and Sonia take very good care of their clients. I feel incredibly lucky to have found such skilled and caring professionals. Your dogs will thank you!

Been coming  to the original location for years  and now at the new location, and still an amazing place that does an amazing job, people here are really nice and care about our pets and it shows. 5 stars

We always have a great experience at Dog House. They make our dog’s haircut look super cute, tons of compliments, and she always comes back smelling amazing. The team is super friendly and accommodating, and incredibly efficient - in and out within an hour. Highly recommend!
First time here, amazing service, will definitely come back!!
My Pomeranian always looks fantastic after he leaves.  Great place to bring your dog for grooming.
LOVE them!! They’re so kind here&the service is great 💚my pup is all fresh&clean! 🐶🐾all  the groomers are the best!! Highly recommend them 🥰💚💚

Great facility and customer service. We were out of towners from Oakland and made a day trip to visit Universal Studios. Quick replies through emails and when she greeted us in the morning , the care taker was all smiles which put our dog at ease. I am recommend this place if you are making weekend plans in LA and need to board your dog for the day.

We took our dog Louie for his first visit at Dog House. We absolutely loved the grooming cut and styling service. Jasmine and Ruby were so kind and left him looking so adorable ! Will definitely be coming back .

We bring our very nervous and anxious Maltipoo here every couple of months for a full groom. The staff are very friendly and know how to work with our kind of dog to get her through the experience (which she has not liked in the past). The grooming work has been great and reasonably priced. The staff let's us know that she has been doing better each time and the last time she did great! Will continue to go there for grooming services. Thank-you!

Sonia is always the best!!! Every time I see her I just know my sweet pup is going to be taken care of. She’s so sweet and patient with my nervous girl. The whole experience is always amazing at Dog House! Thanks again!!

They greet and smile very well, no questions there. The prices are also quite reasonable. But unfortunately they didn't cut him well, the dog hadn't been cut for a long time, so he had a lot of tangled hair, they warned me that I would have to cut him short, but I couldn't even imagine that they would make a bald tail for a poodle. But I put up with this, okay, the hair will grow back of course, but when I brought him home, I found a wound on his back near his tail, because the dog was constantly trying to get it, it causes him discomfort. And no one told me, it was very unpleasant to find this out and it was a shame for the dog! Unfortunately, although your location near my house is convenient for me and I really liked the way you greeted us, but we will not come to you with Bambula anymore!

Omg! The Dog House is amazing. The staff were so sweet and my baby, Miso, came out of there looking so good! Ive been struggling for years to find a groomer that could properly de-shed him and deal with his anxiety about touching his feet and booty area, and other groomers would just give up and leave him half finished. At The Dog House, they were so understanding. They listened to me and were attentive to Miso's needs. They asked questions about what I wanted for him down to the very last detail, and they didn't just give up on him because of his nervous behaviors. I feel so comforted by how much they clearly care about all their clients, and I will definitely be bringing my other dogs there from now on.

Got me in at the last minute after a terrible experience at Petco Unleashed up the street. You just won a new customer! Stoked to support a local NOHO business.

Awesome people, great service!

Carlos (the owner) is so polite and welcoming. He patiently explains the packages/ services they offer. I was nervous how my dog was going to react so he invited me to bring him in whenever we were on a walk so he could get comfortable with the groomers.

Sonia groomed my chihuahua, Hercules, for the first time. She was so incredibly sweet, gentle, and listened to my concerns. Hercules loved getting groomed by her and was not reactive like I expected. Absolutely love this place and WILL be returning again.

Wow! The staff there was outstanding. I just moved from Kentucky. Front desk was very welcoming and knowledgeable about dog behaviors and guided me on some tips about my dogs anxiety. Ruby was my groomer and did an amazing job! She was the sweetest and my pup feel special with the affection and treats. For it being a daycare/grooming salon it smelt fresh and clean. Not like the other daycares or grooming salons that smelt pungent of urine. Definitely will be back!

Two bad experiences is enough. Today’s was the worst. No one was there at the time of the appointment bc the front desk person locked the doors and went to the restroom and no sign on door so I almost left and then I came to pick up at 4 when they close only to be told it would be another 15-20 minutes. Both of these issues took
up 30 minutes of my time and no regard at all for that. They need to do better with their front desk people. The groomers are good and caring but the front desk people are a hot mess
Accommodating and efficient. Pleased with great service.

Ive been having my dog, Penny, groomed here by Jasmine for over a year now and am so happy with her cut every time! I am one of those crazy doodle owners who are very picky. But Jasmine always has patience with me, listens and does the cut exactly as I want! She looks like a cute little teddy bear every time! Also Penny gets soooo excited to see her! She loves getting groomed by Jasmine!

Jasmine did my dogs groom and I’m so happy with the results! I keep looking at my dog and appreciating the cut.
